# Support Cecilia’s Over Seas Detention Release

Help Bring Cecilia Home: Urgent Legal Support for US Citizen Detained in China My name is I. Denise Torres, and I'm reaching out with an urgent request to help my daughter Cecilia, a US-born citizen currently detained in China. Our family faces mounting legal expenses that are far beyond our financial means, and time is critical. Our Immediate Need Following the guidance of the US Consulate, we must retain specialized legal representation in China who is specifically an English speaking attorney that can navigate the Chinese legal system on Cecilia's behalf. Legal representation for international clients in criminal matters in China can range from several thousand to hundreds of thousands of yuan China Legal Experts depending on case complexity and duration. For families like ours, working-class Americans with limited resources, these costs are insurmountable without help. The US Consulate has recommended a qualified law firm experienced in representing foreign nationals. Cecilia has not been formally charged at this time and the funds are intended solely to support the current legal process related to her detention. However, we need to secure their services immediately, which requires: Attorney retainer and representation fees for an English-speaking Chinese defense lawyer Communication and translation services to facilitate family contact Personal care expenses for Cecilia during detention, including medical necessities Ongoing legal advocacy through the completion of her case Why Legal Representation Is Critical Cecilia is alone in a detention facility with severely limited communication rights and no phone calls, no family visitation, and no direct contact with us. The US Consulate has been extraordinarily supportive, but they can only conduct welfare checks once per month and cannot intervene in China's legal proceedings. A private attorney is her only opportunity for: Regular advocacy visits (every two weeks, as permitted) Direct communication link between Cecilia and our family Professional legal representation through required proceedings Monitoring of her wellbeing and medical needs The Medical Urgency Cecilia manages diabetes requiring three insulin injections daily. She experiences related complications including severe stomach issues and pain. Ensuring she receives proper medical care during detention is essential, and legal representation is critical to advocating for her health needs. The Process and Timeline Under guidance from the US Consulate, I cannot share specific details about the circumstances of Cecilia's detention, as doing so could compromise the legal process. What I can share is that we're working through official channels and following all recommended procedures to bring her home safely. Both Cecilia and I are US-born citizens. She is a compassionate, selfless young woman who would help anyone in need. Now she needs us to help her. Our goal is to cover estimated attorney fees for legal representation, communication services that allow us to stay connected with our daughter, and personal care expenses during her detention. Legal fees in China vary significantly based on lawyer experience, case complexity, and whether specialized English-language services are required Lawzana. International representation for US citizens detained abroad requires substantial financial resources that our working-class family simply doesn't have. Every Day Counts Without proper legal representation, Cecilia faces this situation alone—unable to communicate with her family, uncertain about the process ahead, and managing a serious medical condition in a foreign country. Every contribution, no matter the size, brings us closer to securing the legal help she desperately needs. How You Can Help Donate any amount you can afford—every dollar helps Share this campaign widely across your networks Keep Cecilia in your thoughts—this support means everything to our family The US Consulate continues monitoring her welfare, but only an attorney can advocate for her case, facilitate our communication, and work toward her safe return home. Our Gratitude Thank you for taking time to read Cecilia's story. Your generosity during this incredibly difficult time gives us hope. As a mother watching my daughter face this ordeal from thousands of miles away, your support is a lifeline. With deep gratitude and hope, Irma Denise Torres

title: Donate to Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology, organized by Uyghur Anthology
summary: The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. The
content:
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.

<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>

We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.

All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.

Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.

**Our Story**

There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.

To sum up, the issues were:

*   No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
*   A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
*   Lack of awareness of opportunities
*   No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature

So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.

<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>

The blurb from our first volume:

_"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience._

_By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."_

We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.

Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.

Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:

"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."

Our stats:

*   44 pieces in total by 36 contributors
*   Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
*   All work translated into English
*   11 translators
*   Contributors based in over 10 countries

<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>

**Volume 3**

Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.

**How we'd like to proceed**

*   **Supporting the editors -** all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
*   **Supporting our contributors -** we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
*   **Recruiting more people -** paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
*   **Enhance our level of expertise -**we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
*   **Expand our network -**we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.

<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>

**Who we are**

**Munawwar Abdulla** is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.

**Sonya Imin** is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.

**Maidina Kadeer**is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

**Craig De Meillon**

Donation protected

 My name is Craig De Meillon, and I am based in Miami, Florida. I work in safety and emergency management and am a trained firefighter and EMT with professional experience responding to disasters, emergencies, and humanitarian situations.

 I am raising these funds as an independent volunteer to support my deployment to the areas affected by the recent mudslides and flooding in Nepal near the China border. I am not a family member or representative of anyone affected by the disaster, nor am I collecting these funds on behalf of a government agency or other organization. I am responding independently based on my emergency-response experience and my ability to bring useful communications and search equipment into the field.

 The funds raised will be used primarily to cover the direct costs of my deployment and emergency-response work. This includes my airfare and ground transportation to and within the affected region, accommodation and essential field logistics, food and other necessary expenses while deployed, and emergency-response equipment and supplies.

 A significant part of the funding will also be used for search and communications capabilities. This may include purchasing or renting drones that can be used to conduct aerial searches, assess inaccessible areas, locate people who may be stranded or missing, and help response teams understand conditions on the ground. Funds will also be used for satellite communications equipment and associated Starlink service costs so that I can maintain reliable communications in areas where local telecommunications infrastructure may be damaged, unavailable, or overloaded.

 Where practical, I may purchase essential supplies locally rather than transporting them from the United States. This allows funds to be used more efficiently and can also support local businesses and responders.

 The primary beneficiary of this fundraiser is me, Craig De Meillon, because the funds are being raised to cover the actual expenses I incur while independently deploying and carrying out this emergency-response work. The money is not being raised for personal profit or general living expenses. It is intended to offset the costs directly associated with the mission, including travel, equipment, communications, transportation, and necessary field expenses.

 Once on the ground, I will coordinate as appropriate with local emergency responders, humanitarian organizations, community leaders, and other response personnel to determine where my skills, equipment, and communications capabilities can be most useful. My role and activities may change depending on the needs identified in the affected areas and the accessibility and safety of the region.

 I will keep records of mission-related expenses and provide updates throughout the deployment so donors can understand how the funds are being used and what work is being carried out on the ground.

 Thank you to everyone who contributes, shares this fundraiser, or supports the response in any way. Every contribution helps make it possible for me to get the equipment, communications, and resources needed to reach affected areas and assist where I can. Flood

content: 作者：林保華 Newtalk 新聞 2026-10-4 今年10月2日（週五）， 台股 收盤加權指數是48475.74，香 港股 市收市是恆生指數23972.29，台股超越港股一倍有餘！ 2023年11月28日，台股加權指數在暌違25年後，首次在盤中「超車」香港恆生指數（當日台股收盤17,341點，港股盤中最低跌至17,303點）。此後台股一路上揚，領先港股。2024 年 9 月底，中國政府推出了一連串強力的經濟刺激政策來暴力救市，引發熱錢瘋狂湧入香港股市。適逢台灣在 10 月 2 日（週三）因山陀兒颱風台股休市，而當天香港恒生指數正常交易且出現報復性暴漲1310點，而台股因為休市一天，而前一日收盤指數是22390.39點，因而被港股超車，但是10月3日台股復市大漲，重新超越港股，頭也不回了，兩地股市台股越拉越遠。到這次，是那時10月2日的兩週年，居然拉到港股的一倍！ 這個光輝的十月，是台灣的光輝，還是中國的光輝？10月2日這天，台股正常交易，收盤升122.25點（0.25%），台積電甚至跌了10元（台積電每跌5元指數則跌約40點）。香港股市10月2日則是中國國慶假期後復市第一天，可是中國股市因為「黃金週」還沒有復市，因此沒有「北水」（來自中國的資金）來撐盤，居然信心不足因此跌了640.98點（2.6%），港股指數遂不足台股的一半。而在9月30日收盤後，港股還洋洋自得第三季度的表現優於日韓台股市。 台股的表現，今年是全亞洲第一。它來自於蔡英文時代脫離中國的經濟能量的積累。馬英九時代因為依賴中國導致台積電、聯發科等台灣優秀企業險些被中國紫光收購，因此那時台灣股市才8千點。是太陽花運動否決了與中國的服貿協議，阻止了台灣經濟的下墜，使蔡英文時代股市漲到兩萬點超越港股；到了賴清德時代更是飆到4萬多點漲了一倍有餘，漲勢仍未結束。這些就是民進黨執政的成績。 雖然目前還是貧富不均比較嚴重，然而，最低薪資則已從馬英九時代的2.3K拉上到接近3萬元，明年元旦起，將突破到3萬元以上。目前平均薪資接近5萬元，若加上年終獎金、績效獎金及加班費等非經常性薪資，總薪資平均則高達71,165元。薪資的差距主要是行業的不同，這是結構性問題，必須努力解決。貧富不均不可能消滅，但是要盡量縮小。大批「小白」投入股市，只要謹慎從事，會有助提高收入，政府與金融界要正確引導他們。 而香港的不幸，則在於股市集中表現在幫助中國企業上市，所謂「IPO」，這些企業良莠不齊，許多只想刮走香港投資者的資金。有些剛上市刮走一批資金，馬上就配股在刮走一筆，尤其與北水合流掀起炒風。那些高科技股，還在虧損階段，但描繪出天堂般的美景，把價格炒上數倍十數倍幾十倍，一有壞消息出來就崩跌，倒霉的是那些受騙的小股民。 例如今年4月20日香港媒體報導，新股市場大旺，惟上市公司質素惹關注，最少4家上市不足一年的半新股因帳目存疑停牌。9月22日則報導新股市場繼續排隊競逐巨額資金，但已上市的二、三線股亦紛紛伸手作小額集資。中國置業及大森控股相繼配售並淨集資1004.5萬港元及5220萬港元用於還債；GEM板海納星空及玖方數智亦加入集資行列。大森控股配股價是市價的八折。連這點小錢都要搶，似乎世界末日到來了。但是，特區政府洋洋自得IPO全球第一，涉及為祖國服務，眼看許多人受騙，很少人敢公開批評避免唱衰祖國經濟而觸犯「顛覆國家政權罪」，香港股市的沉淪也就難免。 但台灣股市的蓬勃發展，國民黨無恥的當作是他們的功勞，不去感謝政府、企業界與民眾的辛勞，把稅收當作他們選舉時政策買票的武器，好像這些錢是他們家裡搬出來的一樣，可以隨便揮霍。實際上，台灣還有許多低收入者，還有許多老弱需要政府扶助；為解決人口問題需要龐大資金鼓勵生育及教育；還有一些逢暴雨必災的地區需要必須的工程，有過去不足的，也有新產生的；而為了民眾的安全也需要增加軍費、強化武備；面對AI革命，需要多少資金投入跟上也是見步行步。而居安思危更是基本常識。因此，怎麼可以為一場選舉而賭上所有身價，甚至不夠還要借債，這還要我們的子孫如何活下去？而這些身價卻不是傅崐萁掙來的，卻由他做別有用心的「慈善家」。 這些敗家仔、這些紈絝子弟，必須滾出台灣政壇，讓「 洋流 」沖刷出台灣實實在在的民主。

视频加注文字，中国Z世代为何迷上玄学拜佛？ 什么是“心灵经济”？

**中国Z世代为何迷上玄学拜佛？ 什么是“心灵经济”？**

Published 3 小时前

中国年轻人涌向寺庙、算命、塔罗牌和各类灵修产品。这未必是因为他们找到了宗教信仰，而是因为在充满不确定性的时代，他们正试图寻求一丝寄托。

面对就业、收入与未来的焦虑，许多人希望藉此寻求运气、心安以及掌控感。对某些人来说，这意味着去寺庙上香祈福或算命求签；对另一些人来说，则是购买号称能带来好运的手鍊、符咒等各类产品。

商界也敏锐地捕捉到了这一趋势。无论是品牌还是寺庙，都正积极抢滩这个日益蓬勃的“心灵经济”（spiritual economy），将古老传统与现代神秘学转化为针对新一代消费者的商品与体验。

本集Asia Specific节目将一同剖析：这究竟是精神信仰的真正复兴，抑或只是年轻人在面对日益迷茫的未来时，另一种求个心安、分散风险的方式？

title: 支持乖乖工人罢工，团结争取工作权及补偿！

content: 国际社会主义道路（ISA台湾） 10月2日清晨5点，食品厂「乖乖」工会正式发动罢工。乖乖中坜厂企业工会以先前高达94%的压倒性同意率取得合法罢工权后，158名工会会员集结、拉起罢工纠察线，发动创厂半世纪以来的首波罢工行动！ 罢工的起因为今年7月30日，乖乖母集团「三地」集团将中坜厂的土地与厂房以新台币56.72亿元的高价，出售给日月光投控，以配合其半导体封测扩厂抢占AI市场的需求。然而在生产线上长年领取接近最低工资的基层劳工，竟是看新闻才知道工厂已被出售。资方拒绝给予合理资遣费与补偿，而且变卖工人多年付出心血才有的工厂，为了抵抗这些压迫，乖乖的劳工团结起来斗争了。 三地集团因AI产业扩充而赚取数十亿元的地产暴利。资方迟至9月1日才宣布中坜厂将迁厂至新竹，但随后又说词反复不一，引发厂内150多名长年工作的基层员工的不满。资方要劳工自己吸收未来迁厂随之而来大增的交通与住房等迁徙成本，等于变相逼退劳工，而且资方利用西侧厂区将于6个月后租约到期的事实，来合理化将基层工人推向离职的生存威胁。 乖乖的基层劳工沦为AI产业扩张下的受害者，可见AI产业的扩张从来与真正改善工人生活无关，只是延续旧有的老板专制与剥削。而且，乖乖工厂明明就是劳动的结晶，如今却沦为资产阶级房地变卖的玩物，乖乖工厂的一切理应由工人集体共有，从而使工人能集体民主决定厂房的去留，讨论如何继续营运转型，或决定关厂并将所有房地和机具变卖所得，全数用于补偿遭解雇工人的生活、转职与退休，并从长年在乖乖的劳工身上榨取利润的三地集团的财富中得到补充。 罢工行动面临了来自资方与国家机器联合的破坏尝试。据报导，辖区中坜分局警方在上午接获报案抵达现场，要求驾驶巡逻车穿越纠察线进入厂区。在工会成员坚持抗争下，警方尝试突破罢工纠察线的企图暂时罢休。接着，乖乖公司资方竟透过疑似仲介人员，两度带领约30名外籍移工抵达现场，试图强行穿越罢工纠察线进入厂房以企图恢复生产线运作。此举引发纠察线外工会成员的反弹，双方在工厂门口爆发争执与冲突。但工会成员成功呼吁了不是工会成员的移工不随仲介与资方起舞，瓦解了资方企图分化抗争与破坏罢工的企图，而这也是由于移工中也存在团结的情绪，例如移工带水果去关心纠察线上的工人。这也显示了不分国籍的劳工意识到彼此的利益休戚与共时展现出的斗争潜力，因此也需要将移工组织在工会的斗争中。 面对资方的挑衅，乖乖工会随即于10月2日下午在罢工现场召开临时会员大会。会中以几近全数通过的票数，决议将原本仅为期一天的警告性罢工升级为无限期罢工。工会干部更宣告，若三地集团董事长持续神隐、拒绝亲自出面签署正式的团体协约，抗争强度将全面升级，不排除将战线向南延伸，直接动员劳工前往高雄三地集团总部进行长期抗争。我们肯定工会行动的升级并为之鼓舞，工人确实需要竭尽一切可能扩大动员，才可能确保最终罢工的胜利，因为当罢工不可避免的发生时，老板希望工会故步自封内耗倒退、想要工人把罢工当作只是一时警告老板的集会，而非进行到底的斗争。 乖乖工会发起的罢工斗争为想通过集体行动以实质改善生活条件的台湾劳工树立了榜样。这是自2019年机师、空服员罢工；2022年台铁员工集体休假以来，睽违数年的罢工斗争高潮。目前艾杰旭工会也已宣布下周一开始罢工，美光、中华电信、台玻等更多工会也将发起罢工投票。 这显示更多劳工开始意识到必须组织起来，才能阻止资方从劳动者创造的蛋糕偷走越来越大的份额。需要建设群众斗争以废除继承自白恐时期以来的工会组织门槛、政治罢工禁令与跨企业联合罢工限制。跨企业联合罢工是重点之一，因为也只有将斗争连结至其它公司和产业工人的共同组织行动，才能够阻止资本家联合起来转移订单等等破坏罢工的行径。 国际社会主义道路主张： 全体基层劳动者共同支持乖乖罢工，争取工作权、关厂补偿与调高薪资。 建设民主决策、积极斗争的工会组织。 动员全体工人阶级召开大会，共同讨论并投票制定运动的下一步。 协调跨产业的工人共同行动，建设团结斗争，不被老板们各个击破。 支持本外劳团结共同组织工会，争取同工同酬，增加工作岗位分摊工作量。 连结并建设群众斗争，打破工会高组织门槛、政治罢工禁令与跨企业联合罢工限制。 這篇文章 支持乖乖工人罢工，团结争取工作权及补偿！ 最早出現於 中国劳工论坛 China Worker 。

title: 郭华萍白天伪装亲民市长，夜间操控诈骗园区，假面终被撕碎。
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 2024年3月份的时候，菲律宾警方对班班市的一个大园区进行突击搜查，并且解救出了将近七百多人，其中有二百多名中国人。很多人本以为要去国外赚取高额工资，在到达之后却发现自己的护照已经被没收了，而且也没有任何自由可言。 经过一番调查之后，人们很快就想到了一个大家都知道的名字——班班市前任市长郭华萍。她曾经用亲民的形象去参选，并且和选民们握过手，也做出过要改善民生的许诺。但是现在警方正在对她的行为进行调查，并且把她的行为同园区内发生的网络诈骗、人口贩卖、非法拘留等犯罪活动联系在一起
content: 2024年3月份的时候，菲律宾警方对班班市的一个大园区进行突击搜查，并且解救出了将近七百多人，其中有二百多名中国人。很多人本以为要去国外赚取高额工资，在到达之后却发现自己的护照已经被没收了，而且也没有任何自由可言。 经过一番调查之后，人们很快就想到了一个大家都知道的名字——班班市前任市长郭华萍。她曾经用亲民的形象去参选，并且和选民们握过手，也做出过要改善民生的许诺。但是现在警方正在对她的行为进行调查，并且把她的行为同园区内发生的网络诈骗、人口贩卖、非法拘留等犯罪活动联系在一起。 本案最大的焦点，并不是诈骗园区有多大，而是该官员与园区经营的关系到底是什么样的。 郭华萍于2022年成为班班市市长。后来人们才知道她的出生以及身份信息都有问题。菲律宾调查机构用指纹对比的方法得出结论说她是中国人，并且在中国东北地区；她在填写选民登记表的时候所用到的出生证明也被人怀疑是伪造的。警方还认为，“爱丽丝·郭”这个假名其实是冒用的，而真实的爱丽丝·郭已经有好几年没出现过了。 身份之谜并不是整个案件的内容。调查人员把目光投向了班班市郊的一个工业园区。对外宣称是科技园或者博彩业等等，但是实际上却有进行网络诈骗活动的办公室以及员工宿舍存在。2024年3月份的时候，警察就发现了很多外国人在园区里被关押着。 很多人就是被“高薪招聘”的诱惑所吸引而来的。招聘信息上说工作很轻松，并且包吃住，等人们到了国外之后就会把手机和身份证拿走，并且还要他们去从事网络诈骗活动。获救的人来自中国、越南、印度尼西亚等国。 园区内常见的诈骗手段有网络交友、虚假投资等等。所谓的“杀猪盘”就是先骗取受害者的信任，然后让受害者把钱转入假网站。调查人员正在查看园区里的设备、文件以及资金流动情况，并且想弄清楚诈骗分子是如何作案的，他们的资金去了哪儿。 园区所采取的措施也引起了人们的注意。获救的人说，不接受工作或者想要逃跑都会受到威胁甚至被打。警方正在对人口贩卖、洗钱以及非法拘留等罪行进行调查。园区土地下发现了遗骨的事情也使案件变得更加严重了，但是有关死者的身份以及具体的情况还需要根据调查的结果来确定。 使执法人员警觉起来的是，园区的部分水电以及日常开销据说是由班班市政府来支付的。该细节并不能单独说明市长直接参加了每一桩罪行，但是它使得人们不得不怀疑：这样一个庞大的工业园区，在此地能够长久存在下去的原因是什么？地方政府管理、执法方面是否有工作人员为违法犯罪活动提供方便？ 郭华萍一方曾经辩解称，自己只提供场地不涉及园区犯罪。警方仍然在对她的行为以及园区经营人、资金账户之间是否存在关联进行调查。调查资料还把她的名字和很多家公司以及国外银行账号联系在一起了，而这些财产的来历和去向都需要通过司法途径来一一查证。 案件的转机来源于一个逃跑出来的越南人。2024年3月份的时候，他带着伤跑了出来，并且对外界求救，有关的情况通过各种途径被传播出去了，在此之后菲律宾方面就进行了突袭。由于身份问题以及园区经营状况相继被披露出来，所以郭华萍成了跨国追捕的目标。 之后她就离开了菲律宾，在马来西亚、新加坡等国之间来回奔波，最后到达了印度尼西亚。2024年9月，印尼警方在巴厘岛将她逮捕。她说自己是为了保护自己的安全才去投案自首，但是外界普遍认为她是无法避免被国际通缉和调查的压力所迫。 警察之后就冻结了她所有的银行账户，并且查封了她的土地和汽车等财产。她的两个主要合伙人也相继落网。关于每个人究竟要承担什么样的法律责任，在后面的司法判定中才会得出结论，并不是在调查过程中就已经确定下来的。 案件被披露之后，在菲律宾国内关于离岸博彩业的争论不断加剧。政府之后就叫停了这些业务，并且想解决行业的遗留问题。对于一般的求职者而言，园区里的被困者所遇到的情况也十分具体：看到“无须工作经验、高薪包办”的海外招聘信息时要先查证公司的资质、职位以及出国的相关手续，不能仅仅依靠老乡来订机票。

content: 蔡康永彻底“塌房”后，深扒他的家族史，果然不简单啊……娱乐圈的“翻车”事件，总是来得这样猝不及防。 万万没想到，这次人设崩塌的会是一直以来聪明圆滑的蔡康永。 事情的导火索，发生在10月4日台北的一场竞选造势大会上。 这场活动的举办方，是被国台办列入台独顽固分子清单的沈伯洋。 然而，镜头往台下扫去，一个戴着口罩和帽子刻意遮掩面容的中年男士，坐在了前排贵宾席上，手里拿着沈伯洋的应援棒，他就是蔡康永。 这个消息传到内地，瞬间引爆了网络。 而市场也很快做出了反应。 就在事件曝光之后，刚刚官宣合作不久的零跑汽车火速发布声明，下线全部相关物料，跟蔡康永划清界限。 紧随其后的是各大平台，他们纷纷开始清理相关宣传素材，一夜之间，蔡康永在内地的多个商业合作全部清零。 在大是大非面前，谁都不能轻易践踏底线。 但蔡康永团队显然还想像以前那样蒙混过关。 他们给出了解释，说只是为了后续采访候选人，过来了解和见识一下，并非站台支持。 但这样的说辞，很难让大众信服。 要真是作为媒体人调研一下，大可以私下预约访谈，根本不需要挤到造势集会的前排，举着牌子为台独分子助阵。 通过这件事，很多人才看清蔡康永的真正面目： 表面上滴水不漏，圆滑通透，实际上却是一个立场模糊，想着两边红利都吃尽的利己主义者。 我们对台湾艺人一直以来的态度就是：我们欢迎你来大陆发展事业，但你绝对不能一边挣着我们的钱，一边还想着“台du”。 这一点，作为在大陆发展多年的“老油条”蔡康永来说，肯定是知道的。 但他却在明白这条底线之后，还屡屡冒犯。 有网友翻出他之前的一些行为和言论，发现他做出如今的选择，完全是意料之中。 有一年金马奖的舞台上，主持人郑裕玲笑着调侃黄渤，说：你怎么穿着睡衣就来了？ 黄渤顺势幽默接梗：我已经把金马奖当成家了，回到家里当然要穿得舒服一点。 没想到当晚身为主持人的蔡康永突然接了一句：这是我家，不是你家。 一句话，瞬间把现场的气氛降至冰点。 黄渤口中的“家”，是把金马奖当成了两岸三地电影人一起交流，欢聚的舞台。 但蔡康永却把这个“共同的家”，变成了某些地区单方面的主场，把大陆的电影人排除在外。 要知道，蔡康永可能是在大陆挣得最多的台湾艺人之一。 他是比较早的一批来大陆发展的电视人。 凭借着《康熙来了》积攒的人气，他趁热打铁，在大陆制作了现象级电视节目《奇葩说》。 网传他单季酬劳就达到千万级别，是内地综艺早期的顶级报价。 更重要的是，《奇葩说》帮他吸纳了更多内地的年轻粉丝，让他在《奇葩说》结束之后，各大综艺的邀约接踵而至。 还有他的书《蔡康永的说话之道》，是他在内地最成功的文化产品。 这本书的版税高达千万，常年霸占各大图书畅销榜单。 正是这些综艺和图书，让他“会说话”“高情商”的人设稳稳地立住了，各种广告纷至沓来。 饮品，汽车，多个奢侈品牌的挚友，多项活动，让他在这里赚得盆满钵满。 有媒体估算过他在大陆的收入，在3到5亿人民币之间。 这十几年来，他这套庞大的商业版图，全部都是建立在内地市场的土壤上。 按理说，挣了这么多，不说让你感恩，最起码你得尊重吧？ 但他从来不表明自己的立场，钱挣得哐哐响，立场依然模糊，一边享受内地市场带来的红利，一边在敏感的政治立场上左右摇摆，两边都想讨好，两边好处都想占尽。 但这一次，已经不可能让他走左右逢源的捷径了。 为什么这样一个高情商，聪明通透的人，会在立场上如此模糊？ 其实，翻开蔡康永的家族史，就能找到答案。 蔡康永的父亲蔡天铎，曾在上个世纪40年代跟另外4个同乡合伙创办了一个轮船公司。 而著名的太平轮，就是这个公司的。 1949年1月27日，太平轮因严重超载，撞上了另一艘船只，双方均沉入大海。 当时的太平轮上，有近千人葬身冰冷的海水中。 原本，这个公司旗下别的船都有大型保险公司兜底，但唯有太平轮，因为蔡天铎为了给朋友新开的保险公司捧场，临时更换了保单。 事发之后，面临巨额赔偿，保险公司宣布倒闭跑路，这笔赔偿一下子落在了5个股东身上。 但大难临头，蔡康永的父亲却做出了一个让人瞠目结舌的抉择。 他迅速变卖了内地家中的资产，举家逃难前往台湾。 去了台湾之后，他转行成为了一名律师，在当地站稳脚跟，仍然过上了上流社会的生活。 多年之后，蔡康永还在文章《我家的铁达尼号》里提到过太平轮沉船事件。 但他的文字里，更多的是感慨家族命运的落败，惋惜自家财富的流失。 而那近千名遇难者和他们背后的家庭，他却只字未提。 而跟蔡家做出相反决定的，是一个叫周庆云的股东。 他选择留在了大陆，独自面对所有的官司，所有的股东都撤离了，只剩下他一个人在兜底。 他坚持承担债务，用尽一生持续偿还遇难家属的赔款。 最艰难的时候，他和家人甚至卖血也要还清债务。 直到生命的最后，他家财耗尽，仍然嘱咐后辈坚守这份承诺和良知。 1949年到1982年，周家三代人接力才把这笔钱彻底还清。 这个历史故事， 照见了两个不同的家族，最深刻的人性底色。 周家这一生，都在践行着“一诺千金”的重量，选择用自己和后代的人生，去承担责任。 而蔡家出事了就一走了之，在他乡过得风生水起，完全枉顾那千名遇难者背后的责任和眼泪。 从始至终，他们都没有摆脱这种精致利己的人性底色，没有民族大义，没有任何担当可言。 历史的车轮滚滚向前。 如今，这个命题又重新摆在了他们面前，而蔡康永的选择，依然跟当年他父亲一样。 通过这件事，网友们彻底看清了，那些模糊立场的骑墙派，那些在关键问题上遮遮掩掩的人，多半是有问题的。 任何一个逃避责任，弃民族大义于不顾的人，也许能吃到一时红利，但躲不过长久的清算。 在大是大非面前，我们不能容忍任何可以操作的模糊地带。 同样是台湾艺人，同样在内地市场发展，但人与人之间的选择，却是云泥之别。 前几天，艺人吴奇隆晒出自己国庆期间去天安门看升旗的照片。 他手持红旗，为祖国献上祝福。 很快，这条动态发布之后，他在台湾的一个活动就被宣布取消。 但他根本没有在意，持续更新自己去天坛游玩的视频。 有网友在评论区留言：想来赚钱就好好坚持住这个立场。 吴奇隆在下面回复：不赚钱也是这个立场。 一句话，表明了自己的态度：一个中国的立场和原则，不是用来交换商业利益的筹码。 艺人张韶涵，从出道起，就坚定一个中国的原则。 她曾多次公开表态，“台湾必将回归祖国的怀抱”，“祖国统一，势不可挡”。 因为这些言论，她长期遭受岛内某些媒体的攻击，但她从未改变过立场。 还有台湾老牌综艺演员方芳，多年前就定居大陆，一直坚称台湾迟早要回归； 主持人侯佩岑，在还没有来大陆发展事业之前，就一直持续转发央视新闻，坚持台湾回归祖国。 这些艺人们，是发自内心的认同血脉同源。 这份信念，无关商业代言，无关事业版图，而是真正相信，祖国统一是大势所趋，是民心所望。 反观那些骑墙派，总想着左右观望，红利吃尽，却不愿意承担相应的立场担当。 人心的高下，在这些对比中一目了然。 现在，所有网友的眼睛都是雪亮的。 在大是大非的立场上，再也没有所谓的“中间派”，界限就在那里，谁都不能轻易模糊。 漂亮的文字，儒雅的人设，圆滑的情商，这些也许可以蒙蔽一时，但关键时刻的选择，才照见一个人的本心。

source: 中国民主党洛杉矶委员会

content: 作者：杨长兵 编辑 ：吕聪 继2025年美东行，时隔一年，9月20日，我们再次出发前往华盛顿DC，参加抗议习近平访美的活动。 我与法师（吴占科）和朱荣耀三人驾车从自由雕塑公园出发，全程5000多英里，用时8天，于23日凌晨2点到达华盛顿居住点。简单休整后，上午我们三人驾车前往白宫附近，与陈创闯带领的中国民主党全委会成员汇合，反对以李成钢为代表的谈判小组在白宫附近举行会议。我们在建筑物附近高声呼喊：“中共下台！习近平下台！” 大约下午2点左右，我们驱车前往安德鲁斯空军基地附近，与众多来自纽约、旧金山、华盛顿、洛杉矶等地的民运组织汇合，共同参加反对习近平访美的抗议活动。 到达现场后，我们发现有七辆大巴车载着大量亲共人员到达现场，他们的人数明显多出我们民运人员好几倍。当我们得知，在半小时之前，他们就已经与我们的民运成员发生冲突，并故意损坏民运人员的设施。警方随后分别把我们和亲共人员分开，严阵以待，以防再次发生冲突。 我们展示黑色中共旗帜，表达对中共极端统治的不满，持续抗议了大约两个多小时。后来发现亲共人员陆续撤离，才得知习近平车队绕开了我们的抗议地点，直接前往其下榻的酒店。 24日上午，我们各路民运组织在白宫西门集结，集体抗议以习近平为首的中共访美活动，持续高声呼喊“习近平下台”“中共下台”等口号，同时呼喊支持台湾独立、香港独立的口号。 与此同时，包括民运前辈魏京生先生、黄慈萍女士、中国民主党全委会主席王金涛先生、六四纪念馆馆长王丹先生、自由雕塑公园陈维明先生、中国人权联盟主席金秀红女士、付希秋牧师、张伯笠牧师等人士到场支持我们，并现场发表演讲。 大约下午3点左右，我们多个民运组织举行了盛大的游行活动，从白宫西门游行到白宫北门。随后，我们在富兰克林广场与新疆人、维吾尔人、香港人、台湾人汇合，再次举行游行活动。 参加游行的人数大约超过千人。大家从富兰克林广场出发，游行到白宫北门，高声呼喊反对中共独裁、要求中共下台、习近平下台，反对中共暴力统治、种族灭绝以及中共境外渗透、跨国镇压等口号。 值得一提的是，24日傍晚正是特朗普与习近平在白宫举行晚宴的时间。我们在白宫北门持续高声呼喊“习近平下台”“中共下台”等口号，我们相信，白宫里面包括特朗普、习近平在内的人员，都能够听到我们抗议的声音。 我们就是要让美国和全世界知道，中共为首的习近平是一个实行高度集权统治的中共领导人，中国人民长期受到中共政权的压迫与迫害。现如今中共已经实行器官国有化，视人民如草芥，为续命150岁，想让谁消失就让谁消失。并制造散播新冠病毒毒害全世界，导致全球上千万人死亡，我们要求追责中共，赔偿全球受害者。 我们要求中共下台，习近平下台，还人民民主与自由；要求中共立即释放高智晟、王炳章、黎智英，释放所有在押的政治犯和良心犯！ 我们也希望，中国有一天能够和美国一样，早日实现真正的民主与自由，让中国人民真正享有民主、自由、人权与尊严。

title: 让服装说话：论中国古装运动的行动逻辑与文化符号

content: 作者：赵燕涛 编辑：吕聪 中国古装运动从一开始，就不是一个只停留在口号上的概念。 我们不只是喊口号，不只是做网络宣传，也不只是发表文章、发表演讲。我们更希望把一种理念带入现实生活，让政治表达不再只是少数人的事情，而是可以通过一种简单、和平、具有文化意味的方式，进入普通人的日常生活。 这也是中国古装运动与传统政治宣传方式不同的地方。 一、从“喊出来”到“穿出来” 长期以来，公共表达往往依赖文字、演讲、集会、标语和网络传播。 这些方式当然重要，但在信息高度碎片化的时代，一个普通人的注意力可能只有几秒钟。 那么，有没有一种表达方式，不需要长篇大论，却能够让人第一眼就产生疑问？ 中国古装运动尝试给出的答案是： 穿上它。 如果一个人生活并不顺利，如果他对现实存在不满；如果他因为言论表达受到限制而感到压抑；如果他因为网络防火墙而无法自由获取信息；如果他对医疗、食品安全等现实问题感到焦虑；如果他对孩子未来的生活环境感到不安——他未必需要发表一篇长篇政治文章，也未必需要站到街头发表演讲。 他可以穿上一件传统服装。 这一件衣服本身，就可以成为一种表达。 当然，一件衣服无法解决现实问题，也不可能代替制度改革。但是，它可以让一个人的态度从“心里的想法”，变成一种可以被看见的公共符号。 这就是中国古装运动所希望探索的第一件事情： 让政治表达从“说出来”，变成“穿出来”。 二、为什么是古装？ 有人可能会问：为什么一定是中国传统服饰？ 因为服装从来都不仅仅是服装。 在人类历史上，服饰一直承担着身份、文化、权力、阶层和时代记忆等功能。 中国传统服饰尤其如此。 汉服、唐装、宋制、明制等不同历史时期的服饰，本身就承载着丰富的中国文化记忆。当这些服饰出现在现代社会，它们会天然形成一种“时间上的错位”。 而这种错位，恰恰具有表达意义。 一个生活在现代社会的人，突然穿着具有历史象征意义的服装走进现实生活，别人看到的可能不只是一件衣服，而是一个问题： 为什么他今天要穿成这样？ 问题一旦产生，传播就开始了。 因此，中国古装运动并不是简单地鼓励大家“复古”，也不是单纯的传统文化展示。 我们更希望把传统文化符号重新放进现代公共空间，让它成为观察现实的一面镜子。 三、当“龙袍”成为镜子 中国古代最鲜明的权力象征之一，就是龙袍。 龙袍代表皇权，也代表一种高度集中的权力秩序。 而在今天，当“皇帝”“龙袍”等历史符号重新被用于政治表达时，传统服饰便可能产生一种非常有意思的反讽效果： 当权力重新披上象征皇权的服装，普通人也可以用服装作为镜子回应它。 我们不需要与它争夺“龙袍”。 我们甚至不需要直接喊出很多口号。 我们只需要穿上属于自己的传统服饰，让这种文化符号与现实形成对照。 于是，服装开始说话： “看，有人在开历史倒车。” 这可能就是中国古装运动最核心的视觉逻辑。 不是用暴力对抗暴力，而是用符号回应符号；不是用另一个权力神话取代旧的权力神话，而是通过文化反讽，让人重新思考权力、历史与公民之间的关系。 四、从一个人的表达，到一群人的行动 任何一种社会运动，如果永远停留在网络文章和口号层面，就很难真正进入现实。 因此，中国古装运动强调“行动”。 这里所说的行动，并不意味着暴力，也不意味着破坏。 它可以非常简单。 一个人去上班，可以穿传统服饰。 一个人去参加文化活动，可以穿传统服饰。 一个人去公共场所，可以穿传统服饰。 一群朋友聚会，可以穿传统服饰。 参加和平表达活动，也可以穿传统服饰。 甚至一个普通人只是拍一张照片、录一段视频，把自己的传统服饰分享在社交媒体上，也可以成为这种文化表达的一部分。 当一个人的行为变成十个人的行为，十个人变成一百个人，一百个人变成一千个人时，一个原本陌生的符号就可能逐渐形成社会认知。 这就是新媒体时代的传播逻辑： 不是等待别人替我们发声，而是让每一个人都成为传播者。 五、我们真正希望传播的是什么？ 中国古装运动传播的并不是某一件衣服本身。 我们真正希望传播的是一种思考： 中国人究竟应该成为怎样的公民？ 传统服饰只是载体。 服装背后的问题，才是我们真正关心的问题。 我们希望人们重新思考个人与权力的关系，重新思考自由、尊严、法治、公共参与以及个人责任。 我们也希望传统文化不再只是博物馆里的历史标本，不再只是影视剧里的视觉元素，而能够成为现代社会中的一种文化语言。 传统文化可以是美的。 也可以是有思想的。 更可以参与公共讨论。 如果一件传统服装能够让一个年轻人第一次开始思考“什么是公民”“什么是权力”“什么是自由”，那么它就已经超越了一件普通服装的意义。 六、真正的行动，不一定轰轰烈烈 很多人认为，改变必须是一件轰轰烈烈的大事。 但历史上很多重要的社会变化，最开始往往只是一个非常微小的行为。 一个人拒绝沉默。 一个人开始提问。 一个人开始阅读。 一个人开始表达。 一个人开始拒绝把某些事情当作理所当然。 然后，第二个人出现。 第三个人出现。 最终，个人行为形成公共意识。 中国古装运动希望做的，正是从一个非常简单的动作开始： 穿上它。 你不需要成为政治家。 不需要成为意见领袖。 不需要拥有大量粉丝。 你甚至不需要发表一篇长篇文章。 如果你认同这种表达方式，那么一件传统服饰，就是你能够选择使用的公共语言。 七、让服装成为一面镜子 我们并不认为一件衣服能够解决所有问题。 医疗问题不会因为一件衣服而消失，食品安全不会因为一件衣服而改变，信息壁垒也不会因为一件衣服而自动消失。 但公共意识的形成，本来就不是靠一件事情完成的。 它需要无数人的思考、表达和行动。 中国古装运动所做的，是尝试增加一种新的表达方式： 让文化成为政治表达的语言，让服装成为公共讨论的媒介，让普通人拥有一种简单而和平的行动方式。 我们穿上古代的服装，并不是因为我们想回到古代。 恰恰相反。 正因为我们不想回到过去，所以我们才要把过去穿在身上，让它成为今天的一面镜子。 当有人重新披上“龙袍”，我们就穿上自己的传统服饰。 当权力试图把历史变成神话，我们就用历史提醒现实。 当有人试图让社会忘记过去，我们就让文化成为记忆。 最终，我们希望服装自己说话： “看，有人在开历史倒车。” 而我们要做的，是继续向前。 衣服不只是衣服。 当它成为镜子，它就能够映照时代。 这，也许就是中国古装运动真正想探索的意义。

title: A hacking campaign has been running for years. Federal cyber strategy is catching up.
summary: **Terry Gerton**The Justice Department is now describing years of Chinese intrusions affecting government agencies, critical infrastructure, and private sector targets. You’ve been watching this for a while. At this point, what kind of conc
content:
**Terry Gerton**The Justice Department is now describing years of Chinese intrusions affecting government agencies, critical infrastructure, and private sector targets. You’ve been watching this for a while. At this point, what kind of conclusions should we be drawing about these campaigns despite years of federal cybersecurity investment?

**Rich Kolko**I think we can be looking at this as the trouble that’s just not going to go away. We’ve all heard the same phrase for years that we’re playing catch-up every time on these cyber threat actors, and they’re not going to end. We don’t have the ability, capability, funding, personnel to find and defeat all of these opportunities, certainly at the government level, and that’s why there’s so much responsibility among private corporations, citizens, anybody with a computer or a device has a responsibility to help keep their device safe for their own purposes, but in reality for the government as well.

**Terry Gerton**When you see an operation like this, this QTFY, what are the attackers really going after?

**Rich Kolko**Well, they’ve been around now, I believe, since 2018. So it sounds like old school as far as cyber actors are concerned. They’re doing a couple different things. They’re trying to infiltrate into our multiple computer systems throughout multiple important government agencies. And they’re doing it in an interesting way. There’s a, at the cyber task force run by the government, you can see an actual real-time threat indicator. And you see where some of these attempted hacks and attacks are coming from overseas. Well, in reality, if that happens, if we can see an attack coming from China, there are entities in the U.S. government that can quickly put a stop to that. But what they’re doing here is they’re kind of trying to go around the corner. They’re infiltrating into smaller systems throughout the country. So it doesn’t appear that it’s coming from China or from QTFY or from wherever. So the problem is they are embedded in local different networks, home computers, companies in the federal government, harder to detect, harder to recognize, and there’s enough validity where they may look real. So that’s certainly a problem. And this gives them a lot of advantages long-term. It’s kind of like having, think of a NFL football game where you’ve got the other team’s playbook, okay? They’re able to look and see what some of our, what NASA, what the Federal Reserve, what DOJ, what are they doing, what are looking at? So they’ve got a heads up. You know, even something as simple as, where they’re preparing a secretary to go up on the hill and testify. They could get access to some of that testimony in advance. They could know what policies the U.S. Is working on in advance, so having that playbook distinctly gives them an advantage and our people have to be ready to defend against that.

**Terry Gerton**One of the things we hear in the conversation around post-quantum cryptography is that even encrypted information is not safe from these kinds of attacks because they can exfiltrate it and decrypt it later. Is that maybe some of what’s happening here as well?

**Rich Kolko**I think that’s certainly a possibility. They’ve got time. It’s not so much critical. I think one of the other important things that they’re doing here is once they’re embedded in here, we’ve heard about the critical infrastructures of the United States, whether it’s banking, water, energy, internet. I think there’s 16 different infrastructure critical ones. If they’re able to embed in some of these, if someday there is an actual conflict between the U.S. And in this case, China, some of what they put in place cause harm on those infrastructure because they’ve got the resources in place. Could they affect our water? Could they effect our finances? Could effect our energy? They possibly could. What an unfortunate, I hate to say it, what a tremendous asset for them in an actual conflict where it’s not just the site of the conflict, wherever that might be, Taiwan or wherever the U.S. could come head to head with China, but they could be causing problems back here in the states and that would detract from everything else that the U.S. has to do to address those issues. We’ve seen some recent issues with getting into water systems around the country. So it is possible to do, it’s a problem.

**Terry Gerton**Richard Kolko is a retired US Navy commander, Navy pilot, and retired FBI special agent. So Richard, you mentioned critical infrastructure and the Trump administration’s recent cybersecurity and national security documents place a lot of emphasis on defending critical infrastructure and disrupting attackers. Given what you’re seeing here, is what’s in those strategies sufficient, responsive, or even relevant?

**Rich Kolko**It’s absolutely relevant and while the current administration is certainly a prioritize this, they’re not the first ones to do this. This goes back several administrations where these critical infrastructures have been identified, recognized as critical, obviously, to keeping the U.S. Operating in the way it is. So whether NSA, FBI, CISA, other organizations, DHS, many organizations have been working to protect these critical infrastructure from these cyber attacks. So, we’ve got the potential for physical attacks, which has always been there, some sort of terrorist attack, physically, but certainly in reality, in many ways, smaller. I mean, if they attack one facility, that’s a problem, but if they attacked all the facilities via cyber, which they may have the capability of, maybe not today, but, certainly, in the future, they could. So, yes, prioritizing how to protect those multiple critical infrastructures has to remain at the highest possible level for the U.S. government.

**Terry Gerton**A lot of cyber discussions in small organizations or local operations like water treatment plants still revolve around keeping the bad guys out, protecting the cyber border, if you will. It sounds maybe like that ship has sailed. How can folks think differently then about operating through attack if it’s too late to try to keep them out.

**Rich Kolko**Well, if you look at a joint terrorism task force, and I served on one in the FBI for several years, that’s mostly government people sitting in the space doing those counterterrorism investigations. But when you talk about cyber investigations and cyber task forces, what’s interesting and unique is now they’re bringing in the companies. They’re giving members of these companies clearances. They’re sitting in FBI space. They know the same information the FBI knows, and the FBI know what some of these companies and critical infrastructures know. And by them working together, they can help build up that fence, as you called it, to help protect from some of these hackers or intruders trying to get into the system. Not perfect. And again, as I mentioned earlier, the problem is it’s always with these guys playing catch up. They’re always, you know, three steps ahead. And so the U.S. government always has to work very hard to try and stay caught up to them.

**Terry Gerton**Is one of the ways to avoid the catch-up game, thinking more about just resilience. If you know that they’re already gonna be there, can you focus your planning on how to operate in the event of an attack, operating through an attack?

**Rich Kolko**Oh, absolutely they can, but the trick there is it’s expensive and a lot of organizations or private companies are often, I hate to say this, they’re hoping it happens to the other guy and not to them. So they don’t want to spend as much money as they can or should on some of the defensive measures that are necessary. So you know, putting up those cyber fences or actual fences to protect physical locations, a lot of times that falls by the wayside and whether it’s a bank or an ISP or a water treatment facility in the middle of the country, they’re thinking it’s going to be somebody else. So they may not always spend the dollars that are necessary, and you can’t force them to. It’s just difficult.

**Terry Gerton**Well, there’s an expression I’m sure you’re familiar with. Hope is not a method. So if you’re trying to focus on a method here, if you are a federal CIO or a CISO, where would you place your next dollar? Would you put it on preventing intrusion, detection, or recovery?

**Rich Kolko**Oh boy, that’s a great one. I think preventing intrusion is great, but detection is a big problem right now. As we just saw with this Chinese cyber hack, it’s been going on for years. It took years to detect what was occurring. So once, I guess you have to do it in order. If you can detect it, you can try and do something to mitigate it. But if you can recognize it before it happens, you could hopefully stop it earlier in the cycle. All problematic, I think it’s like the kind of like the intelligence circle. You’ve got to do all of them at the same time in order to be effective. And a lot of that just comes up to strengthening these partnerships. I think they’ve gone a long way, a long with doing that over the last 10 years. FBI, DHS, NSA, they have these partnerships with these not just government organizations, but private companies. And that is critical. And they’re building capabilities, not only inside the government, but inside these organizations. Sharing the information, sharing the intelligence, sharing the threats, and it’s all part of the game and it is a game that’s not gonna stop. And we need to make sure we have the right people in place and as you know, there’s been probably a reduction of personnel across some of the government entities. That’s caused a problem. And of course, everybody who works in the cyber industry on the government side thinks that, hey, I can jump over to some of these private companies and double my salary. So that’s a concern as well.

content:
**6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING room at bliss available M-SU 8AM-8PM. We have implemented an in-house scheduling calendar that Practitioners may reference to determine an available mutually beneficial time if the recommended time below is not convenient for you.**

**This is a private 1-hour session. Please RSVP directly to the Practitioner to book the session time and then go to [givetobliss.com](http://givetobliss.com/) to make a $33 donation via VENMO (no fees), PayPal or credit card. Thank you!**

**Reiki** is a Japanese energy healing technique developed in the early 1900’s by Mikao Usui to stimulate health and vitality through channeling life force energy. While promoting a deep state of relaxation, Reiki therapy may reduce stress, anxiety, and pain through gentle touch and transferring of energy. The practitioner delivers this energy through their hands to assist in improving the recipients biofield flow and balance on the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual levels. By having a tranquil effect on the mind and body, Reiki promotes healing and restoration while having a favorable influence on the parasympathetic and autonomic nervous systems.

**Access Bars** was developed by Gary Douglas as a set of tools and processes applied to facilitate more consciousness. As a restorative modality, Access Bars involves the practitioner connecting with 32 points on participants head through gentle touch. This contact facilitates the release of negative energetic thought forms, ideas, beliefs, emotions, and considerations that create barriers. As energetic blockages are discharged, a rebalancing occurs making room for improved thought patterns. Results may include a more peaceful mind, relaxed body, improved outlook, stress relief, more energy, and feeling replenished. Measurements of electrical activity of the brain conducted after an Access Bars treatment were shown to have literally calmed brain activity down.

**Facilitator: Lisa Ann Helmly,MS,RDN,LDN, [lisa@lisahelmly.com**](http://lisa@lisahelmly.com**/)

*   Holy Fire III/Karuna Reiki Master
*   Certified Kundalini Reiki Practitioner
*   Certified Access Bars Practitioner
*   Passionate about inspiring people to optimize their health and wellbeing.
*   Small changes yield big results.

As a Low Country Native, Lisa is enthused to share complimentary integrated healing and restorative modalities to promote optimal health and well-being. Holding a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration equipped Lisa to gain experience in the corporate environment, flip residential housing properties, and continue managing her rental property business. Completing a Master of Science in Nutrition as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist prepared Lisa for working in the medical sector assisting patients with a variety of illnesses, disease states, and conditions. During this time to the present, Lisa pursued further studies in alternative and integrative health practices attaining multiple credentials. While working in these areas, Lisa continued serving in her roles as a mother, daughter, sister, and friend.

**Sounds Productive Right? Does Being More Productive Support Health and Well-Being?**

“Getting busier does not necessarily make you better…affectively managing your stress does!”

You really didn’t think all of that activity was done perfectly with complete ease and grace, did you? Of course not. As Lisa was stressed out creating elevated levels of cortisol and adrenaline, this lack of balance was in opposition to a positive state of health and well-being. How ironic is that behavior? Lisa more fully understands how stress and being out of balance can have a negative impact on the mind and body. Sometimes the vehicle that drives a person to do, may eventually run them over. Hypothetically speaking, imagine being in a hit and run accident driven by yourself in your very own car. Can you relate now? The coping mechanism of burning the candle at both ends is comfortable because it is familiar. However, the candle may eventually burn out.
 If there is one commonality that we all have in this human experience, it’s managing our own life stressors. Add a dose or two of trauma along the way and what do you get…**Amplified Stress with Triggers.** The well-being sessions are offered here for interested participants to explore complementary and integrative approaches on processing and managing stress to ultimately feel and function better. You are invited to take this peaceful exploration on optimizing your own health and happiness.

title: Eswatini king thanks Taiwan for helicopter donation - Focus Taiwan
summary: Tainan, Oct. 11 (CNA) Visiting King Mswati III of Eswatini on Sunday thanked Taiwan for its previous donation of military helicopters to the African kingdom as he toured an aviation training center in Tainan accompanied by President Lai Chi
content:
Tainan, Oct. 11 (CNA) Visiting King Mswati III of Eswatini on Sunday thanked Taiwan for its previous donation of military helicopters to the African kingdom as he toured an aviation training center in Tainan accompanied by President Lai Ching-te (賴清德).

King Mswati III arrived in Taiwan on Friday for his 20th visit to the country since he was crowned king in 1986, primarily to attend the Republic of China National Day celebrations. The Republic of China is Taiwan's formal name.

On Sunday, Lai and the monarch visited the Army Aviation and Special Forces Command's Flight Training Command, a military unit based in Tainan that serves as a training facility for Army aviation.

During the visit, King Mswati III and his wife, Inkhosikati Make Zuma, were shown military helicopters on display in a hangar. Both also tried their hand at operating a military helicopter flight simulator, while the king sat in the cockpit of a Black Hawk helicopter.

In his remarks during the visit, Lai said Taiwan donated two retired UH-1H helicopters to Eswatini in 2020. Between 2019 and 2020, the Tainan-based command also trained 11 Eswatini pilots and maintenance personnel to operate and maintain the helicopters.

Lai expressed his gratitude to the personnel involved in the mission for their contributions to diplomatic ties between the two countries.

Meanwhile, King Mswati thanked Taiwan for donating the helicopters and assisting in the training of Eswatini's pilots.

The helicopters, which were formally handed over to the Umbutfo eSwatini Defence Force (UEDF) Air Wing, have already played a crucial role, including transporting patients who are unable to reach medical facilities on their own or require urgent medical attention, the king said.

Mswati added that during his current visit to Taiwan, he witnessed the continued development and progress of Taiwan's aviation sector. He said he looked forward to further deepening exchanges and sharing expertise and experience between the two countries.

The king's itinerary also includes observing a joint ground-air military exercise alongside Lai, a visit to an agricultural research center and an investment dinner hosted by Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍), according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

The African kingdom's ruler is expected to conclude his latest Taiwan trip on Oct. 17.

(By Yang Szu-ruey and Joseph Yeh)

title: 城寨國際 | 和平獎得主被指是中共維吾爾種族滅絕幫兇

content: 城寨 臉書 2026-10-10 諾貝爾和平獎最新得主國際刑事法庭南非籍法官皮萊，曾任聯合國人權高級專員，他的得獎對維吾爾人嚟講是狠狠刮了一巴，背後涉及一宗稱為「聯合國名單分享醜聞」（UN Name-sharing Scandal）重大政治風暴。 聯合國人權事務高級專員辦事處（OHCHR）被踢爆，長期在人權理事會召開前夕，將計畫出席會議並發言的中國異議人士及人權活動家名單，「提前」提供給中共政府。此舉導致多名維吾爾族及西藏活動家在中國境內的家屬遭到株連與迫害，引發國際社會對聯合國誠信與保護人權職責的強烈質疑。這起跨越十餘年的國際司法與外交醜聞，隨著吹哨者的持續揭發以及相關高層的政治風波，其來龍去脈與歷任聯合國高級人權專員的角色，再度成為國際輿論聚焦的中心。 吹哨者撕開內幕：機制化的「名單共享」 整起事件的起點可追溯至2013年。時任聯合國人權辦公室的英籍人權律師艾瑪·萊利（Emma Reilly）赫然發現，中國駐日內瓦代表團的外交官會定期向聯合國官員索取即將在聯合國人權理事會（HRC）上作證的異議人士名單。 這些名單中包含了準備就新疆再教育營、西藏人權及香港局勢發聲的活動家，其中最引人注目的是世界維吾爾代表大會領袖多里坤·艾沙（Dolkun Isa）。萊利指出，這種「提前通報」的做法嚴重違反了聯合國保護人權捍衛者的核心原則，形同將異議人士及其家屬置於險境，隨即在內部向高層提出強烈抗議與通報。 嚴重後果：北京按圖索驥與家屬株連 隨後的法庭證詞與多名維吾爾活動家在各國國會的聽證會上證實，這份被聯合國官員私下分享的名單，為北京當局提供了精準的「打壓名單」。 中國國安單位在提前獲悉出席人員後，隨即在新疆等境內地區對活動家的家屬實施恐嚇、任意拘留與審訊。多名活動家沉痛表示，他們的父母或兄弟姊妹正是因為其名單外洩，隨即被關入新疆再教育營，部分家屬甚至在營中受虐死亡。此外，中國外交官更利用這些提前取得的身份資訊，在聯合國會場發動程序干擾，試圖阻止這些人權活動家進入大樓發言。 高級人權專員皮萊的角色：縱容中共作惡 在整起醜聞的發展過程中，多任聯合國人權事務高級專員的處置方式與態度，被外界批評為「向北京的外交與經濟施壓屈服」：作為吹哨者首次通報的高級專員皮萊被指控在2013年接獲萊利的內部報告後，並未立刻叫停該項做法或展開實質調查。萊利在法庭上控訴，皮萊及其核心幕僚當時採取冷漠與規避的態度，甚至將涉及洩密給中方的官員予以晉升。由於皮萊因其一生的國際法貢獻獲頒2026年諾貝爾和平獎，這段歷史在2026年10月再度引發國際人權組織（如 UN Watch）與維吾爾團體的強烈抗議，痛批其為「種族滅絕的幫兇」。

content: 韩连潮   X @lianchaohan · Oct 10, 2026 【 美对台政策的不变与变 】沈伯洋最近一段走红的讲话中，特别提到，美国的台湾政策始终是不改变台海现状，而台湾的主权独立正是现状的一部分。这个解读是对的。9月川习会后，美国国务院发言人和美国驻华大使庞德伟也多次公开重申，美国对台政策没有改变。 但我认为，在中共党国已经打破美中建交时的承诺、不断破坏台海现状的情况下，美国若仍以维持原有政策不变为原则，实际上就是一种让步和倒退。 十几年前，我就提出，美国的台湾政策应当与时俱进、更新升级。 美国对台政策以《台湾关系法》、美中三个联合公报以及对台“六项保证”为基础，在所谓“一个中国”政策框架下，维持台海现状。这些法律文件和政策安排，都形成于台湾民主化之前。30多年来，在美国的支持和推动下，民主制度已经深深植根于台湾社会，台湾也成为亚洲民主的楷模和灯塔。一个成功实现民主转型、拥有成熟民主制度的台湾，与当年制定这些文件时的台湾早已不可同日而语。美国对民主台湾的责任，也理应随之加重。原有的法律文件和政策框架，已经不能充分反映这一现实。 与此同时，对岸的中共党国早已从建交之初的良性改革开放，退回到对内镇压、对外扩张的社会帝国主义。它不断挑衅、破坏美中建交时的台海现状，在经济、科技、军事和国际秩序等各个领域与美国对抗，直接威胁美国的国家安全。在这种情况下，美国如果仍把维持原有政策框架当作不可逾越的界线，等于把紧箍咒死死地套在自己的脑壳上。 川普第二任期之初，美国国务院删除了拜登政府时期事实简报中的“我们不支持台湾独立”这一关键表述。此举引起北京严厉批评，也引发外界对美国对台政策是否转向的猜测。然而，川普政府官员随后通过公开表态和外交渠道澄清，美国对台政策和“一个中国”政策并没有发生根本性改变。 到了2026年5月中旬，川普在北京与他的“老朋友”握手言欢后，接受采访时却公开警告台湾不要奉行台独政策。他声称：“我并不希望看到有人搞独立。我们要跨越9500英里去打一场战争？我可不想看到这种情况。” 问题在于，台湾历届民选总统和政府公开主张的都是维持现状，并没有以推动法理独立作为执政纲领。川普却在这样的背景下发出警告，将台湾追求自身政治前途的问题与美国是否要为此打一场战争挂钩。这番话传递出的，不只是对台湾独立的明确不支持，更是要求台湾避免触怒北京、不要把美国拖入冲突的降温信号，以取悦习近平。 然而，据传，在2026年9月于华盛顿举行的川习会期间，习近平再度施压，要求美国将官方立场从“不支持台湾独立”升级为“反对台湾独立”，但遭到川普拒绝。 我认为，“不支持台湾独立”的政策，在台湾尚未民主化、台湾人民尚未通过民主程序决定自身政治前途的时代，或许还可以解释为一种维持两岸稳定的战略安排。但今天，面对一个已经实现民主化、由人民通过选举决定执政者的台湾，美国若继续把“不支持台湾独立”作为政策禁区，就不仅与民主原则自相矛盾，更是在事实上限制台湾人民决定自己政治前途的权利。 联合国宪章开宗明义确立了人民自决原则。美国一方面自诩为民主世界的领导者，另一方面却以“不支持台湾独立”限制台湾人民的政治选择，这种自相矛盾的政策和说法，都亟待改变。 不仅如此，事实已经证明，单靠维持台海现状的吓阻战略，并未能阻止北京步步进逼。中共从未放弃吞并台湾、剥夺台湾主权的野心，反而不断以武力威胁、外交打压和灰色地带行动破坏现状。如果一方可以不断改变现状，另一方却把“不改变政策”当作原则，画地为牢，那么所谓维持现状，最终维护的究竟是谁的利益？ 所以，美国对台政策既要不变，也要变。 不变的是对台海和平稳定的承诺，是对民主价值的坚持，也是对台湾人民自主决定自身政治制度和命运的尊重；必须改变的，则是那些形成于台湾民主化之前、已经无法充分回应现实挑战的政策框架，以及在中共不断破坏现状的情况下，仍然自我设限的战略思维。 美国不能让中共以不断改变现状的方式，迫使美国永远停留在过去。对台政策与时俱进、更新升级，不是破坏现状，而是为了阻止北京单方面改变现状，捍卫台湾人民决定自己命运的权利。

content:
**Gather monthly to explore where our Autism, Neurodiversity and Psychedelic experiences meet**, as well as how each plays out separately in our lives.

In many circles talking about autism, neurodiversity or psychedelics can be awkward or even taboo. **This is our space to explore and share, unmasked**. Come as you are, with your fidget toy, your quirks and special interests, and all that is uniquely you. This is an inclusive group where all are welcome, including allies.

We'll start each meeting sharing guidelines to help us co-create our meetups with comfort and flexibility, knowing that our guidelines will evolve over time. Then we'll have brief check-ins to help us get to know each other. Following will be time to chat about the topics anyone would like to discuss. **Our shared purpose is to allow us to come together, be our authentic selves, and connect with others who can relate to many of our own experiences.**

**Suggestion** - Bring some paper or a journal, and a pen, to jot down thoughts during the meeting while another person is speaking, so you remember all the brilliant thoughts you had on the topic when you get a chance to speak at the MeetUp! From experience the thoughts will spark. ;)

**Our meetings are monthly online, and we are adding in person events 1-2 times a year**, in addition to the monthly online MeetUps. In person events announced at the online meetings as they are planned.

(Please avoid fragranced products at our occasional in person meetings to support those with sensitivity to smells. We'll do our best to find in person meeting locations with decent lighting, and low levels of auditory distractions. Suggestions welcome on locations too!)

**About the host:**

**Be Friend** is an ordained minister in a non-denominational "church without walls" for over 16 years, a late diagnosed autistic woman, and an advocate who is steeped in the newly legal psilocybin ecosystem in Oregon. Currently she is in the middle of starting up a psilocybin service center, and an adjacent retreat center. She's been involved since Nov. 2022 with grassroots advocacy, encouraging our state's legislators and the Oregon Health Authority to improve the rules for the Oregon Psilocybin Services Act (OPSA).

Be has also been part of the Autistic Psychedelic Community (APC) for quite a while now and has witnessed and experienced how coming together to chat about being on the spectrum and psychedelics, can be a powerful community building space. So when Aaron Orsini (the co-founder of the APC, and author of Autism on Acid) asked Be to connect with PPS to get a group going in Portland, she jumped at the chance.

************************
 This event is independently organized and is not hosted, supervised, or facilitated by the Portland Psychedelic Society, a donation-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

**To learn more about Portland Psychedelic Society programming, memberships, and more, please [visit our website](https://www.portlandpsychedelic.org/).**

All are welcome to be a part of our evening service. Experience not necessary. Those of any faith or lack thereof are welcome. All that is required is an open mind to learn how to promote wellness, happiness, love, and peace to oneself and all sentient beings. Typically a service will include the following:

*   Check in. (How you’re doing.)
*   Silent meditation, seated on cushion, chair, or one of the pews.
*   Dharma talk from either Thay Kozen or one of five other teachers. (Buddhist teaching on how to alleviate suffering and promote happiness and peace.)
*   Metta practice. (Loving kindness.)
*   Sutra recitation and discussion. (Sutras are the written Dharma teachings.)
*   Much love and laughter.

title: 尼康“小世界·动态”大赛获奖作品系人工智能生成
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 患有罕见遗传疾病儿童气道中的纤毛。（供稿：宁旭） 一名因被发现使用生成式人工智能而被取消资格的国际摄影比赛获奖者。 Nikon 表示，该视频违反了年度“微观世界在运动”（Small World In Motion）比赛的规则，该比赛通过显微镜镜头评选最佳照片和视频。 Nikon 在声明中表示，当时中国清华大学光学工程研究员宁旭拍摄的视频“不符合关于生成式人工智能的比赛规则”。 Nikon 表示，该决定是基于视频的资格，并非对参赛者的专业声誉或科学贡献的评判。 比赛争议 获奖者
content: 患有罕见遗传疾病儿童气道中的纤毛。（供稿：宁旭） 一名因被发现使用生成式人工智能而被取消资格的国际摄影比赛获奖者。 Nikon 表示，该视频违反了年度“微观世界在运动”（Small World In Motion）比赛的规则，该比赛通过显微镜镜头评选最佳照片和视频。 Nikon 在声明中表示，当时中国清华大学光学工程研究员宁旭拍摄的视频“不符合关于生成式人工智能的比赛规则”。 Nikon 表示，该决定是基于视频的资格，并非对参赛者的专业声誉或科学贡献的评判。 比赛争议 获奖者公布几天后，显微镜专家开始在社交媒体上质疑该视频的准确性。 获奖者的视频展示了微小毛发状结构在患有罕见遗传疾病——原发性纤毛运动障碍（PCD）儿童气道中飘动。 Dr Xu 的视频被放大 100 倍，展示了覆盖气道以清除黏液的纤毛。 他的视频声称使用一系列复杂的光波以彩色照亮样本的不同部分，使研究人员能更好地理解 PCD。 质疑该视频是否真实的 Bluesky 海报截图。（ABC：供稿） 佛罗里达大学的副教授 Edward Phelps 表示，细胞核的图像“不像细胞核那样行为”，而纤毛“凭空出现，且不符合已知尺寸”，他在 Nikon 的 LinkedIn 帖子评论区留言。 Nikon 随后删除了该帖子。 显微镜社区向比赛写了一封公开信，呼吁对获奖者的工作进行外部审查。 “一种可能具有误导性的 PCD 描绘正在塑造公众对这一尚未被充分理解的罕见疾病的理解，”信件中写道。 它呼吁诊断和研究 PCD 的医生和研究人员签署该信件，并推动 Nikon 执行其自身规则。 新获奖者 线虫和单细胞生物 Dileptus 在显微镜下。（供稿：Nam Nhat Nguyen） 在争议之后，越南研究人员 Nguyen Nam Nhat 因其拍摄的显微镜下线虫遇到名为 Dileptus 的单细胞生物的视频而获得一等奖。 该视频最初获得第二名。 今年 9 月，ABC 公布了始于 1975 年的比赛获奖者。 该视频是比赛中数十个被选中的视频之一，包括海洋水滴中的水母幼虫和生物发光闪光。 水母幼虫悬浮在水滴中，放大 25 倍。该视频在 2026 年 Nikon“微观世界在运动”比赛中获得第三名。（供稿：Benedikt Pleyer） 获奖者将获得价值 3,000 美元（约合 4,300 美元）的奖金。 比赛面向全球任何对通过显微镜进行电影或延时摄影感兴趣的人开放。 ABC 已联系 Dr Zu 寻求评论。

## Details

**Protest with SHL! ✊ in front of Charleston City Hall at 2 pm on Sunday, October 11.**

Join us as we stand up for **First Amendment freedoms**—including the separation of church and state, press freedom, and freedom of speech and assembly.

📢 Bring a sign if you’d like (we’ll have extras on hand if you don’t).

To comply with Charleston’s restrictive protest ordinance, we’re capping this action at **24 participants**. Please RSVP here on meetup.

👉 Why the cap? The City of Charleston requires a permit for protests with more than 24 people and has been forcing permitted groups into out-of-the-way locations like Hampton Park. To make our voices heard in **well-trafficked downtown spaces**, we’re joining Silence Is Not an Option's (SINO) effort to hold **pop-up protests every 2nd Sunday of the month**, each in small groups of 24 or fewer.

Come make your voice heard!

summary: **6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING ro
content:
**6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING room at bliss available M-SU 8AM-8PM. We have implemented an in-house scheduling calendar that Practitioners may reference to determine an available mutually beneficial time if the recommended time below is not convenient for you.**

**This is a private 1-hour session. Please RSVP directly to the Practitioner to book the session time and then go to [givetobliss.com](http://givetobliss.com/) to make a $33 donation via VENMO (no fees), PayPal or credit card. Thank you!**

**Reiki** is a Japanese energy healing technique developed in the early 1900’s by Mikao Usui to stimulate health and vitality through channeling life force energy. While promoting a deep state of relaxation, Reiki therapy may reduce stress, anxiety, and pain through gentle touch and transferring of energy. The practitioner delivers this energy through their hands to assist in improving the recipients biofield flow and balance on the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual levels. By having a tranquil effect on the mind and body, Reiki promotes healing and restoration while having a favorable influence on the parasympathetic and autonomic nervous systems.

**Access Bars** was developed by Gary Douglas as a set of tools and processes applied to facilitate more consciousness. As a restorative modality, Access Bars involves the practitioner connecting with 32 points on participants head through gentle touch. This contact facilitates the release of negative energetic thought forms, ideas, beliefs, emotions, and considerations that create barriers. As energetic blockages are discharged, a rebalancing occurs making room for improved thought patterns. Results may include a more peaceful mind, relaxed body, improved outlook, stress relief, more energy, and feeling replenished. Measurements of electrical activity of the brain conducted after an Access Bars treatment were shown to have literally calmed brain activity down.

**Facilitator: Lisa Ann Helmly,MS,RDN,LDN, [lisa@lisahelmly.com**](http://lisa@lisahelmly.com**/)

*   Holy Fire III/Karuna Reiki Master
*   Certified Kundalini Reiki Practitioner
*   Certified Access Bars Practitioner
*   Passionate about inspiring people to optimize their health and wellbeing.
*   Small changes yield big results.

As a Low Country Native, Lisa is enthused to share complimentary integrated healing and restorative modalities to promote optimal health and well-being. Holding a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration equipped Lisa to gain experience in the corporate environment, flip residential housing properties, and continue managing her rental property business. Completing a Master of Science in Nutrition as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist prepared Lisa for working in the medical sector assisting patients with a variety of illnesses, disease states, and conditions. During this time to the present, Lisa pursued further studies in alternative and integrative health practices attaining multiple credentials. While working in these areas, Lisa continued serving in her roles as a mother, daughter, sister, and friend.

**Sounds Productive Right? Does Being More Productive Support Health and Well-Being?**

“Getting busier does not necessarily make you better…affectively managing your stress does!”

You really didn’t think all of that activity was done perfectly with complete ease and grace, did you? Of course not. As Lisa was stressed out creating elevated levels of cortisol and adrenaline, this lack of balance was in opposition to a positive state of health and well-being. How ironic is that behavior? Lisa more fully understands how stress and being out of balance can have a negative impact on the mind and body. Sometimes the vehicle that drives a person to do, may eventually run them over. Hypothetically speaking, imagine being in a hit and run accident driven by yourself in your very own car. Can you relate now? The coping mechanism of burning the candle at both ends is comfortable because it is familiar. However, the candle may eventually burn out.
 If there is one commonality that we all have in this human experience, it’s managing our own life stressors. Add a dose or two of trauma along the way and what do you get…**Amplified Stress with Triggers.** The well-being sessions are offered here for interested participants to explore complementary and integrative approaches on processing and managing stress to ultimately feel and function better. You are invited to take this peaceful exploration on optimizing your own health and happiness.

## Details

Join us for a weekly rhythm of meditation, teaching, and discussion led by Swami Satyamayananda. The morning begins with meditation, followed by a teaching on spiritual life and Vedanta. After the talk, those attending in person are welcome to remain for coffee, tea, and continued discussion in our dining room. The bookstore will also be open. This reflects the new Sunday structure beginning May 3, 2026.

Because meditation is now the foundation of the morning, we ask everyone to **plan ahead to arrive and be settled before 10am**. Entering after meditation has begun is disruptive to the meditation period and to those already practicing. Upon arrival, you may choose to join Swami Satyamayananda for Guided Meditation in the Chapel, or enter the Shrine upstairs for Silent Meditation.

This event is held in person at the Seattle Ashrama, and the 10:30 teaching is also [livestreamed on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@vedantasocietyofwesternwa/streams). Like all Vedanta Society activities, it is open to all and free of charge. Past talks may be selected from our [YouTube playlists](https://www.youtube.com/@vedantasocietyofwesternwa/playlists).

**Sunday Schedule**
**10am** Meditation (_Guided in the Chapel or Silent in the upstairs Shrine_)
**10:30am** Teaching (also available on [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@vedantasocietyofwesternwa/streams))
**11:30am** Discuss Vedanta over coffee and tea; [Bookstore](https://vedanta-seattle.org/media/bookshop/) available

_90-minute program, followed by discussion._

[![Image 7: Photo of Team Orenco Cycling group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/7/9/e/5/event_452551205.jpeg?w=3840) ### Team Orenco Cycling](https://www.meetup.com/team-orenco-cycling/)

## Details

**Mark O. Hatfield West Trailhead**
**Note: A day-use parking fee is required at the Mark O. Hatfield West Trailhead.**
 Restrooms are available here.
[https://ridewithgps.com/routes/57425954](https://ridewithgps.com/routes/57425954)

**The first 4.5 miles follow the dedicated paved bike and pedestrian trail**, completely separated from motor traffic. Smooth, scenic, and loaded with history.

*   The **highlight of this segment is the Mosier Twin Tunnels**, two historic tunnels originally built in 1921, widened in the 1930s, then sealed when I-84 was constructed in 1954, and finally reopened in 2000. Riding through their ~390 feet of cool, dimly lit stone is genuinely thrilling, and the archway openings frame stunning river views.

**From Mosier, you'll transition onto Historic Highway 30**, which you'll share with vehicle traffic. Car traffic here is typically light but stay alert and ride single file. This is where the route earns its challenge rating.

*   **The road climbs steadily eastward**, gaining most of its elevation as it winds up through open, sunbaked terrain with sweeping views back toward Hood River and the river corridor.
*   You'll pass the **Memaloose Overlook** roughly 5.5 miles from Mosier (about 415 feet of climbing to this point), a worthwhile stop for views of Memaloose Island and the Columbia river.
*   **Continue climbing another mile and a half or so to reach Rowena Crest**, the dramatic finale of the ride. The total road section from Mosier to Rowena Crest is approximately **6.5 miles one way with around 650 feet of climbing** from the trailhead start.

## Details

**An Introduction to the F.A.S.T. Framework**
 Are you ready to Feel Better F.A.S.T. and Find Peace in the Chaos? 🌿

In this workshop, Michelle Dosanjh-Johal introduces the F.A.S.T. framework — a set of strategies integrating heart, soul, mind and body, created to build resilience in life's most overwhelming moments.

These strategies have helped women:
 ✨ Find peace during their children's hospitalizations
 ✨ Discover a new lease on life at 60 after a lifetime of anxiety
 ✨ Reduce chronic illness symptoms of MS

If you are ready for real transformation, genuine peace, and to finally remember that **YOU MATTER TOO** — this workshop is for you.
 Come as you are. Leave feeling better. 🌿

# Practice and learn Buddhism: In person and Online

[![Image 6: Photo of the user Mary Orton](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/3/d/7/3/thumb_249495731.jpeg?w=96) Hosted by Mary O.](https://www.meetup.com/tibetan-buddhist-learning-and-practice/events/315761167/attendees/)

[![Image 7: Photo of Tibetan Buddhist Learning and Practice group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/3/6/a/b/event_441733995.jpeg?w=3840) ### Tibetan Buddhist Learning and Practice](https://www.meetup.com/tibetan-buddhist-learning-and-practice/)

## Details

We get together the first and third Sundays (usually; watch for changes) to practice The Buddha Path and learn about Buddhism together.

We meet in person in Bend, and we also broadcast online for those who are not in this area or feel more comfortable being online.

Our **face-to-face teachings** are held in the Hawthorn Healing Arts Center, 39 NW Louisiana Avenue in Bend. This is across Louisiana from McMenamins near downtown Bend. There is parking on the street as well as in the parking lot next to the building.

Feel free to dress in shoes that can be removed easily and comfortable, loose-fitting clothing. Bring your cushion if you'd like; there will be cushions and chairs available. You might want to bring something to take notes with.

To **join via Zoom**, please use this link: [https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84113348500?pwd=gZAeKCAdHhGH4dcXwdskvLP0yiGa9U.1](https://us06web.zoom.us/j/84113348500?pwd=gZAeKCAdHhGH4dcXwdskvLP0yiGa9U.1)

_**Please note that we will lock the Zoom meeting a few minutes after the start time, so please be on time.**_

These friendly and informal gatherings are open to everyone, with no previous training required. There is no charge; you will have the opportunity to make a donation to support our local Central Oregon Dharma Center, if you wish.

_Practice compassion: bring a friend!_

When you RSVP, Meetup assumes you are attending online--they somehow cannot handle a hybrid meeting. That doesn't cause any problems for us. Thanks for responding!

Feel free to contact me if you have any questions. I hope to see you soon!

Many blessings, Mary

## Details

Our next meeting is Tuesday, October 13th!

Schedule:
 Social Networking 5:30pm - 6pm
 Talk 6pm - 7pm
 More networking! 7pm - 7:30pm

I'm excited to announce that October's Prairie Python meeting is a Q&A panel with 4 local python experts.
 - Steve Green, PhD (https://www.linkedin.com/in/sgreendatascientist/): Small Business owner and Data Science expert
 - Giovanni Baez Flores, Phd (https://www.linkedin.com/in/gbaezflores/): Machine Learning Engineer and DevSecOps practitioner
 - Sean Mahoney (https://www.linkedin.com/in/seandavidmahoney/): Network Engineer
 - Derek Stearns (https://www.linkedin.com/in/derekstearns/): Data Engineer and Data Scientist

Come with your questions about python's role in the agentic coding shift, the latest Python libraries, how to sort a list or how to learn python. Everyone is welcome to join and ask questions!

Huge shoutout to [Improving](https://www.improving.com/locations/omaha/)for hosting and providing beverages and food:

# Release the Beagles! - Merck Animal Health 🪧 PROTEST 📣

[![Image 5: Photo of the user Brandy Carlson](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/1/8/4/8/thumb_304086216.jpeg?w=96) Hosted by Brandy C. and Jai �.](https://www.meetup.com/dxe-nebraska/events/316649047/attendees/)

## Details

WE ARE PROTESTING OUTSIDE THE FACILITY.
 We are not going through the Merck Animal Health gates. We are staying on public property.

This is a peaceful (non-violent) protest. We are demanding—loudly—that the dogs moved to Merck Animal Health from Ridglan Farms be released for adoption. 📣🪘🗣️

The rendezvous point, where we park our cars and brief, will be a half hour before the protest at a location a few blocks away from Merck. Message an organizer for those details.
 We will walk from there to the protest.

After the protest there will be a meetup at a food joint, so if you want to socialize there is an opportunity for that as well.

[![Image 14: Photo of the user Nicole Elyse](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/6/e/d/a/thumb_326308378.jpeg?w=96) Hosted by Nicole E.](https://www.meetup.com/grow-together/events/316780661/attendees/)

## Details

I have lived in 6 countries, traveled to 45 and all 7 continents, and checked everything off my very extensive travel bucket list by the age of 36.

Ask me anything.

Whether you would like to travel more, are itching to live the digital nomad life, or just want to hear some cool stories from around the globe, join me to chat about life, travel, and the pursuit of happiness.

If you’d like to know more about me and my story in the meantime, check out [https://www.nicoleelysejourneys.com](https://www.nicoleelysejourneys.com/) and my talk on “Why getting robbed at gunpoint in Colombia is the best thing that’s ever happened to me.”

This is not a sales pitch. I do do travel coaching if you want more targeted help getting started, but that’s not what we’re here to talk about. I just like meeting fellow travelers and wannabe travelers.

# Support Pie Formosa’s Independent Work

I sometimes describe myself as a refugee from WeChat to Instagram — but I am also, quite literally, a refugee from China. I am a political dissident, human rights activist, non-binary person and independent writer living with invisible disabilities, now continuing my work in Europe. I write and create public work about censorship, authoritarianism, political memory, democracy, queer and trans freedom, refugee experiences, neurodiversity, and the cultural spaces where resistance survives. For years, WeChat was one of the places where I published my work. Readers could easily support independent creators with small tips. Then the Chinese Communist Party shut down my account. I lost not only a platform, but also an audience, an archive, and a simple way for people to support my work. This fundraiser is part of rebuilding that independence. Living with invisible disabilities also means that conventional employment structures and constant high-intensity workloads are not always accessible or sustainable for me. I need a modest and stable income to make independent research, writing and human-rights work sustainable. Your support will help cover: * research, writing and documentation * travel to human-rights, democracy and civil-society events * digital tools and publishing costs * accessibility-related working needs * basic living costs that allow me to continue this work independently My first goal is €3,500. If something I have written, documented or created has informed, helped or inspired you, even €1, €5 or €10 helps me keep this work alive. If donating is not possible, sharing this fundraiser also makes a real difference. Authoritarianism depends on silence and forgetting. Independent voices survive because people choose to keep them alive. Thank you for supporting my work. Pie Formosa (they/them) https://linktr.ee/pieformosa

Dear Friends,

My name is Alan, and I am writing this with a sincere and humble heart.

I am a Chinese political dissident living in Houston, Texas. Because of my beliefs and my willingness to speak openly about freedom, human rights, and justice, I have faced serious threats and intimidation from the Chinese government. These pressures have made it impossible for me to safely return to China, where my family still lives. Every day, I carry the pain of being separated from my loved ones, uncertain when—or if—I will ever be able to reunite with them again.

Beyond the emotional suffering, I am now facing severe financial hardship. Due to restrictions and complications surrounding the transfer of my personal funds from abroad, I have been unable to access resources that I once depended on for survival. My savings are rapidly disappearing, and I am now struggling simply to cover basic daily necessities such as food, housing, transportation, and medical care.

This situation has left me feeling isolated and vulnerable. I never imagined that standing by my principles would lead to such profound personal sacrifice, but I continue to hold onto hope.

Today, I am reaching out with deep humility to ask for your support. Any assistance—whether financial help, practical resources, or connections to organizations that aid individuals in political exile—would mean more than words can express. Your kindness could help me maintain stability during this incredibly difficult chapter of my life and allow me to continue moving forward with dignity.

I am not asking for luxury, only for the chance to live safely and meet my most basic needs while I navigate these extraordinary challenges.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Your compassion, understanding, and support would be a lifeline during one of the hardest periods of my life.

With deepest gratitude,

Alan

Momo Crawlers, we’re asking for your help.

The disaster at the Nepal-Tibet border has left thousands displaced from their homes, and the full scope of the crisis is still being realized. Many Momo Crawl vendors and volunteers remain concerned for loved ones who are still missing.

Through friends and family, we’ve established contact with mutual aid networks on the ground in Nepal. They are also providing us with live updates on the aid groups they’re seeing, what those groups are accomplishing, and where additional support is most needed.

Our plan is to allocate funds according to the feedback we receive from our contacts in Nepal. In addition to mutual aid groups and NGOs, we anticipate directing a significant portion of proceeds to the Nepali government’s [Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/). This fund accepts digital payments, and we encourage you to donate directly if you prefer: [](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)[https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)

We established this GoFundMe primarily for ease of use and to help us track the impact of the Momo Crawl community. We expect to keep the drive active until Momo Crawl on September 13th, 2026, but donations received now will be allocated to relief efforts on a rolling basis. We will share updates about the use of funds as information becomes available.

With love and gratitude,

The Momo Crawl team

title: 美国对涉嫌与中国腐败有关的斐济商人实施制裁

content: 赵福刚否认了此前关于其涉嫌刑事活动的指控。（供稿：Noya Media） 美国对一名被指控是与中国政府有关联的犯罪网络成员的知名斐济华裔商人实施了制裁。 美国国务院今天上午发布声明，宣布将赵福刚（斐济海外华人社团中心主任）列为制裁对象，因其被指代表中国籍人员从事其所谓“严重腐败”行为。 美国声明称，赵福刚及其直系亲属将因此无法进入美国。 “赵福刚滥用其公职，向斐济公民行贿，以推进中国籍政府、商业和犯罪利益，”美国声明称。 赵福刚未直接回应这些指控，但其律师告诉 ABC 称他们尚未收到调查通知，并表示将致信美国政府以澄清这些指控。 此前，他的律师表示赵福刚坚决否认所有针对他的指控，称其为虚假且具有误导性。 赵福刚（戴黑色面具）及其直系亲属被禁止进入美国。（供稿） 周四，赵福刚在写给苏瓦美国大使馆的一封信中回应了这些指控，否认了行贿指控，并要求国务院撤销制裁通知，直到他有机会做出回应。 “我坚决否认我向斐济公民行贿、滥用公职或从事腐败以推进中国籍政府、商业或犯罪利益的指控，”信件称。 “在斐济没有针对我的正在进行中的刑事程序。” “该声明提出了严重的指控，但未指明所依据的具体行为，其发布和广泛传播对我的声誉和我的家庭造成了严重后果。” 赵福刚还要求国务院提供其涉嫌犯罪的详细信息，以便他提交正式回应。 斐济外交部长萨基亚·迪托卡确认，在 ABC 联系他之前，他并未收到过关于该指定通知的正式通报。 他表示，此类行动的正常程序是通过外交部长向政府发出正式通知。 另一位高级内阁部长表示，针对赵福刚提出此类指控并非首次，并称上次是在两年前。 2024 年，九娱乐公司的《60 分钟》节目和伙伴报纸指控他既是跨国犯罪集团的高级成员，也是中国共党统一战线工作部的知名成员，该部门负责在海外推动北京的利益。 调查新闻机构“有组织犯罪和腐败报告项目”也指控这位斐济国民是涉及毒品走私、洗钱和人口贩卖的犯罪集团的高级成员。 该报告称，赵福刚已被列入澳大利亚刑事情报委员会（ACIC）的澳大利亚优先目标组织登记册，该登记册包括几名被指控对澳大利亚构成刑事威胁的罪犯。 该报告强调，赵福刚从未在澳大利亚或其他地方被起诉，且当局未公开任何针对他的证据。 2024 年，斐济总理西蒂韦尼·拉布卡告诉 ABC，他不知道赵福刚是否作为中国政府的特工工作，并称他有权作为斐济公民享有其权利。 斐济总理西蒂韦尼·拉布卡。（路透社：Mike Segar） 苏瓦美国大使馆在社交媒体上发布声明，称存在“犯罪分子在中国关联下在太平洋地区活动的既定趋势”。 “赵福刚的行为使斐济易受来自中国籍政府、商业和境内境外犯罪分子的有害外部影响，”声明称。 “腐败阻碍了外国投资和外国援助的机会，助长了有组织犯罪，为有害分子提供了便利环境，推动了非法移民，并削弱了公民对政府的信任。” “这直接影响了美国的国家安全、经济和外交政策利益，以及我们伙伴国家的利益，这也是国务院采取这些行动的原因。” 2024 年，中国驻苏瓦大使馆称，中国侨团在斐济的工作“透明、合规且无可指责”，并称赵福刚是斐济公民。 “您对中美关系与斐济华人社区之间关系的怀疑完全是毫无根据的，”其声明称。 赵福刚曾出席多次与中国官员的活动——包括 2021 年和 2022 年在其酒店举办的两国警方联合合作庆祝活动。 时任斐济总理弗兰克·拜尼·拉马纳马和时任中国驻斐济大使张平也出席了十年前他出任海外华人社团中心主任的任命仪式。 坎特伯雷大学太平洋区域安全中心负责人若泽·苏萨 – 桑托斯曾就中国如何利用被指控的犯罪网络作为“战略上有用且可合理推诿的国家工具”进行了广泛论述。 “某些非法行为人在其影响力得以延伸、培养当地精英、产生可推诿的经济杠杆、支持爱国叙事，并在正式国家权力可能引发抵抗的空间活动时，可成为战略上有用的工具，”他告诉 ABC。 苏萨 – 桑托斯表示，虽然美国对赵福刚实施的制裁“较轻”，但传递的信息“清晰”。 “这不仅仅是关于被指控的有组织犯罪，也是关于腐败和外国干涉的指控，”苏萨 – 桑托斯表示。

title: 劉實：「懷仁堂事變」50周年 為何靜悄悄（附韩钢揭秘怀仁堂事变）
summary: 文：劉實 民報【中國透視】2026年10月8日星期四 【明報專訊】1976年10月6日，距離開國領袖毛澤東逝世不足一個月，華國鋒、葉劍英、汪東興發動懷仁堂事變，拘捕「四人幫」（毛遺孀江青以及極左派王洪文、張春橋、姚文元），震驚中外。事件終結文革亂象，改變了中國命運，亦為開闢鄧小平時代奠定基礎，意義重大。不過，「懷仁堂事變」50周年，內地靜悄悄，網上只有一些零星討論。 華國鋒是毛澤東指定的接班人，當時的一號人物，葉劍英元帥是德高望重的老幹部代表，汪東興掌握御林軍（中央警衛局）。
content: 文：劉實 民報【中國透視】2026年10月8日星期四 【明報專訊】1976年10月6日，距離開國領袖毛澤東逝世不足一個月，華國鋒、葉劍英、汪東興發動懷仁堂事變，拘捕「四人幫」（毛遺孀江青以及極左派王洪文、張春橋、姚文元），震驚中外。事件終結文革亂象，改變了中國命運，亦為開闢鄧小平時代奠定基礎，意義重大。不過，「懷仁堂事變」50周年，內地靜悄悄，網上只有一些零星討論。 華國鋒是毛澤東指定的接班人，當時的一號人物，葉劍英元帥是德高望重的老幹部代表，汪東興掌握御林軍（中央警衛局）。當晚，華葉以召開政治局常委會會議為名，在中南海懷仁堂先後宣布對張春橋、王洪文、姚文元實施隔離審查，派人到江青的住所宣布執行同樣的決定。抓捕「四人幫」不射一槍彈、不流一滴血，出其不意，乾淨俐落，整個過程僅用了35分鐘。 官方將之形容為「執行黨和人民的意志，採取斷然措施」，粉碎「四人幫」。不過，也有人視為「宮廷政變」，違反程序，中共元老陳雲表示「下不為例」。不管如何，此舉結束了長達10年的文革內亂，中共元老鄧小平也得以復出，並在1978年年底的十一屆三中全會正式掌握大權。華國鋒則逐漸邊緣化，其執政的兩年多被定性為「徘徊中前進」。 長期只宣傳十一屆三中全會 大概為了突出「第二代領導核心」，官方長期宣傳的是十一屆三中全會，並將改革開放的功勞歸功於「總設計師」。事實上，華國鋒執政期間也倡導學習和借鑑外國經驗，支持寶安（深圳）、珠海搞「來料加工」。 這也引起一些元老後人的不滿。2011年10月6日，一場名為「人民的勝利——紀念粉碎四人幫35周年」的座談會在京舉行。葉劍英侄子葉選基在會上指出，解決了「四人幫」，結束了文革，給全黨和全國人民帶來的是什麼呢？那就是打開了閉關鎖國的大門，解放了思想，解放了生產力。胡耀邦長子胡德平稱，此舉從危難中挽救了黨、挽救了革命，全國範圍內的解放思想，平反冤假錯案、召開十一屆三中全會，啟動改革開放大業，莫不以此為出發點。 「紅二代」凋零再無座談會 進入新時代，對意識形態的管控更加嚴格，亦不希望在黨史等問題出現雜音，加上「紅二代」逐漸凋零，不可能再召開類似座談會。近日，只有與葉胡家族有交集的歷史研究學者王明遠在其微信公號寫了篇〈歷史轉折五十周年的紀念〉的文章，除了澄清「懷仁堂事變」一些傳言，也強調「粉碎『四人幫』對舊秩序的衝擊，對社會覺醒和改革的促進，大於十一屆三中全會，後者只不過是對這種變化結果的承認」。 原文網址：https://news.mingpao.com/pns/%e4%b8%ad%e5%9c%8b/article/20261008/s00013/1791395921923 附： 韩钢教授揭秘：1976年怀仁堂事变
